sources.title: DVRPC regional description
sources.used_for: The accepted county policy has five Pennsylvania counties and four New Jersey counties.
sources.limit: Defines the selected planning region, not a person-location inference rule.

sources.title: GitHub repository REST API
sources.used_for: Stable repository identity and bounded repository metadata are suitable discovery inputs.
sources.limit: Account location, repository ownership and institutional adoption do not independently establish regional authorship.

sources.title: NCBI E-utilities
sources.used_for: Publication identifiers, author metadata and reported affiliations support candidate discovery.
sources.limit: The reviewed site code qualifies a bounded Wistar scope. A publication affiliation does not establish current employment.
sources.documentation_access: The full Bookshelf page returned a browser challenge. The retained source code and official search excerpts informed this bounded assessment; API access remains unqualified.

sources.title: Crossref REST metadata API
sources.used_for: DOI metadata can connect contributors, publications and identifiers.
sources.limit: Metadata access is distinct from rights to reproduce full text. Field availability requires source-specific qualification.

sources.title: arXiv API user manual
sources.used_for: Independent preprint discovery, versioned identifiers and distinct original/updated submission dates.
sources.limit: Author affiliation, journal references and DOI fields are optional. A name-only author record is not verified local identity.

sources.title: Discourse API documentation
sources.used_for: Topic, post and account identities provide a structured forum adapter shape.
sources.limit: Read access and source rules must be qualified per forum installation. No global forum or local-participant inventory is assumed.

sources.title: ORCID registry search tutorial
sources.used_for: Public researcher identifiers and affiliation search provide identity leads.
sources.limit: Public visibility, record source and dates matter. Registry matching alone does not authenticate every claim or current affiliation.

sources.title: ROR data structure
sources.used_for: Organization identities, relationships and location fields can support institution normalization.
sources.limit: An organization location does not establish the location of every member or unit.

sources.title: Official Z3 guide
sources.used_for: Satisfiability checking over explicit logical theories and SMT-LIB replay.
sources.limit: The solver checks the encoded formula and assumptions. It does not establish source truth or arbitrary native SysML execution.
